exposure: abnormal blood pressure variability (ABPV) during pregnancy
outcome: blood pressure changes at different stages of pregnancy
high systolic blood pressure during pregnancy
high diastolic blood pressure during pregnancy
abnormal blood pressure variability (ABPV) during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 445 pregnant women who underwent prenatal examination and delivered at the First Hospital of Hebei Medical University between December 2016 and November 2017.
finding: Blood pressure in pregnant women typically decreases in early pregnancy and then gradually rises, with several pre-pregnancy factors identified as risk factors for gestational hypertension and abnormal blood pressure variability, although neither of these conditions significantly impacted maternal or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Neither high-normal blood pressure nor abnormal blood pressure variability had a significant impact on the delivery method.
